lineage.strategy: Add SEC-filed primary corroboration independent of issuer newsroom presentation for consolidated liquidity, leverage and cash conversion.

observations.fact: IBM reported $7.766 billion of operating cash flow for the first six months of 2026, up $1.695 billion year over year, while six-month free cash flow was $4.760 billion and essentially flat year over year.

At June 30, 2026 IBM reported $8.178 billion of cash, restricted cash and marketable securities and $61.987 billion of total debt; cash and securities declined $6.293 billion from year-end while debt increased $727 million.
IBM returned $3.166 billion to shareholders through dividends in the first six months of 2026 and completed the Confluent acquisition in the first quarter.

risks.risk: Acquisition deployment materially reduced liquid resources while total debt rose; flat free cash flow despite higher operating cash flow warrants separation of acquisition-driven growth from organic cash conversion.

unknowns.unknown: The filing does not isolate realized returns from IBM quantum initiatives; quantum economics remain unproven by this consolidated evidence.

recommendation: Use SEC-filed cash, debt and capital-allocation values as primary source-addressed underwriting inputs and keep initiative-level economics separate.
